repos.pitch: Chimera is a self‑contained Windows 11 installer that bundles a pre‑configured desktop utility suite, enabling immediate use without external dependencies or admin rights.
A proof‑of‑concept tool that demonstrates sandbox escape paths on iOS 26 and 27, allowing developers to explore file system access for testing.
Standalone Windows 11 desktop app that bundles a full worship presentation engine with all features pre‑activated, ready for offline use.
Standalone Windows installer that bundles all dependencies for IMEI repair, enabling offline diagnostics and restoration of device identifiers without external activation.
Mika is an Android AI assistant that controls apps and a built‑in browser via a background screen, using visual input to tap, type, and scroll without APIs.
Pinky lets AI agents control an iPhone or Android phone over MCP, with user approval and optional local models, from a native desktop or mobile app.

Snapintosh is an EL2 hypervisor and toolchain that boots macOS on an ASUS Zenbook A16 with a Snapdragon X2 Elite, providing a Metal/IOGPU stack for Adreno graphics and drivers for input, Wi‑Fi, and NV
Self-hosted analytics platform that tracks website visitors, AI crawler activity, crawl logs, content coverage, and conversions for Generative Engine Optimization.
AIDA 64 Extreme 2026 is a PowerShell installer that provides a pre‑activated, standalone Windows 11 desktop package for hardware diagnostics, benchmarking, and reporting.
Runs a full macOS virtual machine inside a terminal, streaming the screen and accepting input commands via a helper inside the guest.
SignDrop is a proof‑of‑concept that exploits a Windows CLFS authentication flaw to gain local privilege escalation.
UnfairPlay is a Go tool that extracts a FairPlay model from a Mac and uses it to decrypt personalized iOS IPAs without downloading or purchasing apps.
Intern is a variable font based on Inter with weight (100–900) and optical size (14–32) axes, covering Latin, Vietnamese, digits, punctuation, currency, and math symbols.
A React web app that guides users through 32 ESP32‑S3 labs with live pinouts, simulators, firmware code reading, and a readable datasheet.
Floorplan generates an interactive, plain‑English map of a codebase using Claude or Codex, showing files, functions, and their connections.
A PowerShell script that installs Melodyne 5 as a self‑contained, fully activated desktop application on Windows 11, bundling all features and libraries into a single archive.
A Claude skill that generates award‑level cinematic landing pages by selecting media, writing build specs, and iteratively refining the output.
Standalone offline installer for CorelDraw Desktop 2026 on Windows 11, bundling all runtime, assets, and configuration for air‑gapped or restricted‑network environments.
Lobe MyGo is a UI kit that provides 70+ Go components for MyGo native desktop apps, using Lobe UI design tokens and GPU rendering in pure Go.
A Python program that simulates rain and thunderstorms with visual parallax, particle physics, fractal lightning, and procedural audio.
Windows Optimizer 2026 is a standalone offline package for Windows 11 that includes a temporary file cleaner, startup manager, service and task tweaker, and a local CLI helper for maintenance tasks.
MiniCPM-OCR is a lightweight OCR model that parses Chinese and English documents and PDFs, providing region‑level correctness assessment to identify problematic areas.
A real‑time ocean renderer built with WebGPU, featuring FFT waves, whitecaps, sun glitter, and a physically based sunset sky, all in a single 61 KB HTML file.
Decrypts FairPlay‑encrypted iOS apps using a 16‑byte credential from a jailbroken device, supporting SUPF v3/v5 and encrypted arm64 Mach‑O slices.
Co‑op Anything lets an AI agent turn any single‑player PC game into a multiplayer experience by reverse‑engineering the game and providing online or split‑screen play.
Free My TV replaces the default home screen on Google TV, LG webOS, and Samsung Tizen with a fast, ad‑free interface that shows your streaming apps, weather, markets, and live TV with a single button
LearnHarness is an AI agent that plans, teaches, and practices lessons by building a knowledge graph of a learner’s understanding and adapting content accordingly.
A static web chat interface that connects directly to the DeepSeek API, allowing multiple conversations, streaming replies, voice input, and attachment handling without a backend.
Skullet provides smart skeleton states for React, Vue, Svelte, and vanilla JavaScript, measuring content to prevent layout shifts during loading.
Ascii-sharks is a TypeScript library that renders ASCII shark and fish components on an HTML canvas with no external dependencies.
A plugin marketplace that provides workflows and skills for the MiniMax Code AI coding platform, enabling installation of predefined stacks and individual skills.
A PowerShell script that installs a fully configured CorelDraw 2026 Professional desktop build on Windows 10/11, enabling offline deployment without activation or internet.
STE80 Humanizer transforms AI‑written text into concise, human‑readable sentences by removing AI tell markers and applying Karpathy’s STE80 controlled English rules.
